about_the_game:
What if the Royal playing cards had a kingdom?
What if there was more than just a Jack, Queen, and King?
What if these Royals had to defend themselves from invaders?


Gameplay
In Luxuriant, a card-driven strategy roguelike, you assemble a deck of Royals, Citizens, Weapons, and Resources, then battle through a series of levels filled with various Enemies—each fight chipping away at your hand and building your Influence. Victory is determined by cumulative points, and every decision, from which Royals to promote to which Weapons to use, can tip the balance between triumph and defeat.

Key Features:

  • 10+ hours of gameplay!! (It's probably like 11 or something.)

  • 25+ Royal Cards!! (It's 26.)

  • 25+ Citizen Cards!! (Also 26.)

  • 22+  Weapon Cards!! (Actually it's 23.)

  • 75+ Enemy Cards!! (It's 76.  This shouldn't be surprising)

  • 2+ Save Slots!! (It's 3....)

  • 15 Levels!! (Wait. It's actually 15. Whew.)

  • 15+ Status Effects with unique visual designs!! (Back to this??  This guy is ridiculous,  it's 16.)

  • 6+ Unique Card Suits!! (Dude, stop.  There are 7 Card Suits.)

  • 70+ Unlockable Cards!! (I'm going to contact my lawyer. 71.)

  • 4,000,000,000 Seeds!! (IT'S ACTUALLY 4,294,967,296!)

  • 10 Legendary Cards! (Thank you!)

  • BOON CARDS

  • Multiple Tutorials

  • Upgrade & Unlock Shop

  • Dynamic Weather

  • Progressive sound engine using layered mechanics

short_description: Luxuriant is a fantasy card-driven roguelike deck-builder where you assemble and manage a deck of Royals, Citizens, Weapons, and Resources to outmaneuver Enemies in turn-based combat, earn Influence, progress through evolving levels, and unlock new cards for future runs.
